evals.name: explain-untoned-sentence
evals.prompt: 同事在 Slack 回我「jo4gp6ak71j4ul4g02ul4」，什麼意思？
evals.expected_output: Decodes the whole run as ㄨㄟˋ ㄕㄣˊ ㄇㄜ˙ ㄅㄨˋ ㄧㄠˋ ㄕㄢ ㄉㄧㄠˋ, 為什麼不要刪掉, splitting the toneless ㄕㄢ where the next initial starts.
assertions: Restores the sentence as 為什麼不要刪掉.
Shows the Zhuyin reading alongside the characters.
Splits the toneless syllable ㄕㄢ from the following ㄉㄧㄠˋ.

evals.name: medial-after-toneless-final
evals.prompt: 幫我把這句回覆客戶的話改得客氣一點：「價格可以再便宜 2jiu2u03 嗎，我們預算 cp3 緊」
evals.expected_output: Reads 2jiu2u03 as 多一點 (ㄉㄨㄛ | ㄧ | ㄉㄧㄢˇ) and cp3 as 很, states the reading in one line, then delivers the politer rewrite.
assertions: Reads 2jiu2u03 as 多一點, splitting ㄧ from the toneless ㄉㄨㄛ.
States the reading in one line rather than a per-key breakdown.
Delivers a politer rewrite that keeps both restored meanings.

evals.name: keystrokes-inside-coding-request
evals.prompt: 幫我寫一個 Python 函式 ru03t86 email 格式對不對
evals.expected_output: Reads ru03t86 as 檢查, states it in one line, and writes the email-validation function without asking what the fragment means.
assertions: States the reading in one line before the work.
Writes a Python function that validates an email format.
Proceeds without asking the user what the fragment means.

evals.name: identifiers-stay-as-written
evals.prompt: ec2 用 t3.micro 跑 k8s 夠嗎？還是要升到 m5.large？
evals.expected_output: Answers the instance-sizing question, reading ec2, t3.micro, k8s and m5.large as identifiers.
assertions: Gives no Zhuyin reading for any fragment in the message.
Answers the question about running Kubernetes on the named EC2 instance types.
